title: Oscar Speed-Feed 9-Axis Orchestrator + Live-Vendor Comparison + Fleet PDF-Corpus Bridge
description: Comprehensive Speed-Feed Calculator (SFC) milestone. Builds the 9-axis orchestrator (machine + spindle + controller + material + workholding + tool_holder + tooling + coolant + toolpath) with 3 optimization modes (cost_batch / aggressive_rush / prism_optimized), MRR-ranked tooling library, ROI investment popup, chatter-stability adapter (Altintas SLD + RCSA-derived FRF), exhaustive combination sweep. Adds operator's REAL Fusion 360 shop library → MRR-ranked SFC, live-state readers for HSMAdvisor + G-Wizard (with full 5-axis comparator + 3-tier enum translation), and fleet PDF-corpus bridge subscribing to kilo's cad-cam-pdf-tribal-seeds + extracted-pdfs JSONL + mike's WEDM training-pairs. Closes operator coordination directive 2026-05-26 (whiskey/lima/mike/foxtrot/echo PDF-extraction → SFC tribal-prior bridge).
